Hi Philip,

Thanks for the kind words about the 40T, and for the clear questions.

Your order Shop···· is paid, with one Magic Miner 40T from Batch 8 going to (address hidden). The ship date on your order is 7 December 2026, so Batch 8 is unchanged.

On batches 1 to 4, I don't want to give you a date I can't stand behind. Those earlier batches are being reviewed with the factory right now, so a colleague will confirm where they stand. They ship in batch order, oldest first, and nothing about them moves your 7 December date forward or back.

On the carrier: the service is picked when the label is printed, so I can't promise DHL in advance. What I can confirm is that your order ships DDP, so there is nothing for you to pay on delivery, and the tracking number goes automatically to the email you wrote from the moment the label is created. Worth whitelisting us so it doesn't land in spam.

You can also follow incoming batches on their way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The team is offline at the moment and picks this up today at 10am Eastern, and the confirmation on the earlier batches and the carrier will come to you by email.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

From what I understand, the first batch of 40Ts hasn't left the factory in Shenzhen yet.

Sent from [Proton Mail](https://proton.me/mail/home) for Android.

Hi Philip,

Yes, that swap is easy and I can do it from here, no need to cancel anything.

The Hammer Thor P2 is on the shelf at the warehouse serving Australia, 57 units free, and it ships within 2 business days. Two of them come to $758 against the $799 you paid for the 40T, so $41 would be refunded to your original payment when I make the change, 3 to 5 business days to land. Your DDP shipping and your (address hidden) stay exactly as they are, and the plug is matched to your shipping address.

One honest word before you decide, because it is your money. Two Thor P2s give you 20 TH/s for $758. The single 40T gives you 40 TH/s for $799, so you would be halving your hashrate for about the same spend. The T. P2s win on one thing only, which is that they are here now and the 40T is in December. If what you want is hashing in October, the swap makes sense. If you want the best machine per dollar, the 40T is still the better buy.

Your Harlo OS Diagnostics line stays on the order either way.

Just reply yes and I will make the change the same day and send you the confirmation.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
